capabilities: Collect matching callouts into a clickable tracker block linked to source notes
Filter, search, sort, and group callouts with expression-based parameters
Compute summaries (count, sum, avg, median) over callout properties and named filters
Style custom callout types for dark and light modes
Insert callouts from the command palette using saved templates
disambiguation: Not a separate task manager; it indexes callouts where they already live in notes instead of a standalone task list.
extras: Exposes a local search() and summarize() API on the plugin instance for AI agents and integrations; works fully locally with no network services.
problem: Callouts with ideas, todos, and notes stay scattered across notes in a large vault, with no built-in way to review or track them in one place.

relations.evidence: For Claudian or similar tools, you can use the Callout Tracking skill to guide the agent

summary: Query-block plugin that collects matching callouts from the vault into a clickable, filterable index with summaries, sorting, grouping, and custom callout styles.
